Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter & audit-period confirmation

Hi Rachel,

We're starting our assurance review for Redwood ahead of a planned integration and our procurement team asked for the most recent SOC 2 Type II report (and any applicable bridge letter) along with a quick confirmation of the audit period covered. Can you confirm the audit window and share the following if possible: 

- Full SOC 2 Type II report (PDF)
- Any bridge letter or scope clarification (DOCX/PDF)
- A short mapping (CSV) showing which controls were tested (for our SOC2 -> procurement matrix)
- Example telemetry samples (logs/traces) covering the audit period (or guidance on how to provide them)
- Retention and log-collection policy references for the audit period

Also please confirm secure transfer options (S3 presigned, SFTP, or secure SharePoint) and an estimated delivery date. We need materials by 2026-06-18 to stay on our procurement timeline.

Thanks — copying our security mailbox: security-team@acme.com

Samantha Li
Senior Security Engineer, Acme Corp
security@acme.com

--

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-06-07T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter & audit-period confirmation

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear list and timeline. Happy to help. Quick answers up front:

- Audit period: SOC 2 Type II report covers 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31. We can provide a bridge letter if the period you need falls outside that window (short explanation below).
- Transfer options: we can accept S3 presigned uploads (preferred), SFTP, or a secure SharePoint folder. Presigned instructions are attached.
- Target delivery: draft package by 2026-06-14; final by 2026-06-18 if there are no additional redaction/ND issues.

I've attached a short bridge-letter template and an evidence-manifest template to make the intake easier: redwood-soc2-ii-quick-bridge.docx, evidence-manifest-template.csv, presigned-upload-instructions.md.

What we'll include in the initial package (quick summary):
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) — full report
- Bridge letter (if requested) explaining scope & any limited exceptions
- Evidence manifest (CSV) with pointers to sample artifacts and owners
- Select telemetry snapshots and sample log extracts covering the audit period (redacted where necessary)

One-line reply templates you can use when delegating to engineering/infra: 
- "Can you share the production APM export for 2025-06-01 to 2025-12-31 and a short README describing collection points?"
- "Please upload the IAM audit logs for the audit period to the presigned S3 path; map each file to the evidence-manifest CSV."

If you'd like, we can also provide a concise mapping from SIG/CAIQ to the SOC controls we tested — let me know which format works best for procurement.

I will also loop in our internal owners to prepare the manifest and artifacts.

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-soc2-ii-quick-bridge.docx; evidence-manifest-template.csv; presigned-upload-instructions.md
